description.narrative: The proposed Transport Project Preparatory Facility (the Project) will improve the startup efficiency of priority transport projects in the road, railway, and port subsectors by (i) preparing the feasibility studies, detailed design, and procurement documents, and (ii) providing implementation support during the inception stage of project implementation.

Output: Feasibility studies and/or detailed design of transport projects completed. Indicator: At least one project prepared in each subsector Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Out of the four contracts for the consulting services, three contracts for (i) Detailed Design of SASEC Port Access Elevated Highway Project; and (ii) Feasibility Study ($1.78 million); Detailed Design of Colombo Suburban Railway Project ($8.90 million) and Feasibility Study for the Colombo North Port Development Project (3.41 million) were signed in February 2017, January 2018 and February 2020, respectively, generally on schedule. Data Source: Project proposal reports Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2016 Baseline value: N Target year: 2022 Target value: Y Actual value: Y
Readiness of priority transport projects improved

At least 30% of contracts ready for awards before loan negotiation Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Two contracts for (i) Detailed Design of SASEC Port Access Elevated Highway Project; and (ii) Feasibility Study ($1.78 million) and Detailed Design of Colombo Suburban Railway Project ($8.90 million) were signed in February 2017 and in January 2018, respectively, on schedule.
The third contract, Feasibility Study for the Colombo North Port Development Project, was signed on 20 February 2020.
On 6 March 2025, contract for the consultancy service for detail design for extension of Western Breakwater for West Container Terminal II - Colombo Port Expansion Project Phase II, was signed.
In addition to the four major consulting service contracts, six individual consultants were also recruited for a range of services such as railway operations, ticketing and seat reservation design, transaction advisers, and public-private partnership procurement. Data Source: Project performance reports Base year: 2016 Baseline value: N
